conservativeness_correction.rejected_claim: 'quality is monotone non-increasing, therefore serving every customer at tw_end yields the worst-case quality'
why_rejected: pushing every customer to tw_end can violate later time windows, producing a trace outside the admissible set Omega
longer waiting changes compartment temperature / cooling mode / loading times, so the worst temperature history cannot be inferred from monotone time decay alone
lots enter the cold chain at different times, so maximising one customer's service time does not simultaneously maximise every lot's quality loss

required_distinction.stress_scenario_projection: replay a specified late-service schedule and observe whether quality passes -- may be recorded as PROJECTED_SATISFIED_UNPROVEN
required_distinction.conservative_certification: requires a testable inequality Q_cert,i <= Q_i(omega) for ALL omega in Omega_admissible, with Omega defined a priori

conservativeness_correction.until_proven: the label MUST be CONSERVATIVENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED / PROJECTED_SATISFIED_UNPROVEN; D8's install block STAYS
monotonicity_lemmas_that_DO_hold: at a FIXED compartment temperature, quality is non-increasing in elapsed time (coldchain_state.py:405 caps by min(previous, decayed))
at a FIXED elapsed time, a HIGHER compartment temperature gives a higher Arrhenius rate (coldchain_state.py:128-143), hence lower quality

therefore quality is monotone in each argument separately -- but this does NOT compose into a bound over the schedule set, because the schedule moves BOTH arguments and, per the objection, not every point of that product is admissible
conservativeness_correction.forbidden: inflating the number of experiments or selecting easy routes in order to change this conclusion

quality_counterexamples.name: admissibility of the stress schedule
quality_counterexamples.construction: build the late-service schedule (per-customer latest admissible arrival) and then CHECK it against Omega: every arrival <= tw_end, capacity respected, return slack >= 0, order sequence unchanged
quality_counterexamples.expected: if the stress schedule is INADMISSIBLE it must be REPORTED as inadmissible and must NOT be used as a bound; the nominal projection must remain separately reported
quality_counterexamples.must_not: silently presenting an infeasible schedule's quality as the worst case
quality_counterexamples.assertion: stress_schedule_admissible is a boolean in the result and the result carries the violated conditions when False

quality_counterexamples.name: non-precooled field-temperature branch
quality_counterexamples.construction: same route, same duration, one run with precooled lots and one with precooled=False
quality_counterexamples.expected: the non-precooled projection shows a MATERIALLY higher decay rate / lower delivered quality, matching the coldchain_state.py:398-402 branch
quality_counterexamples.must_not: a projection that ignores the precool flag
quality_counterexamples.assertion: delivered_quality(non-precooled) < delivered_quality(precooled) and the recorded branch flag differs

quality_counterexamples.name: per-class thresholds and dynamics applied SEPARATELY
quality_counterexamples.construction: construct lots of several temperature classes on the same route and read each class's own threshold and its own dynamics/rate
quality_counterexamples.expected: each lot is judged with ITS OWN threshold; the result exposes per-class threshold and rate
quality_counterexamples.must_not: asserting the general claim 'class 2 always fails first' -- that depends on initial quality, temperature history, rate parameters and threshold together, so it is NOT asserted as a property; only separate application is required
quality_counterexamples.assertion: every record carries temp_class, threshold, initial_quality and delivered_quality, and the per-class thresholds equal contract.quality.unsalable_quality_threshold[temp_class]

quality_counterexamples.name: projection consistency with actual execution on the same trajectory
quality_counterexamples.construction: on a DETACHED copy, execute the same route through the production machinery (dispatch via _commit / advance), then compare the resulting DeliveredCargoRecord quality and salable against the projection
quality_counterexamples.expected: the projection EQUALS the executed delivery records (same initial quality, same delivered quality, same salable) for the same route
quality_counterexamples.must_not: a projection that computes a different time schedule than the environment executes
quality_counterexamples.assertion: per-order delivered_quality and salable match between projection and detached execution

quality_counterexamples.name: legality-first short-circuit keeps illegal order sets out of the projection
quality_counterexamples.construction: feed the composed certifier a plan containing an unrevealed order, a served order, a duplicated order, and a closed-vehicle entry
quality_counterexamples.expected: the legality gate refuses and the route / energy / QUALITY components are recorded as NOT RUN (not_run_illegal_order_set); the projection is never invoked on an illegal plan
quality_counterexamples.must_not: certify_plan or project_plan_quality running on an illegal order set and silently rescheduling/dropping
quality_counterexamples.assertion: each component reports not_run_illegal_order_set and the responsible legality gate is named

quality_counterexamples.name: bounded admissible-schedule search against the candidate bound
quality_counterexamples.construction: enumerate a coarse grid of ADMISSIBLE schedules (per-customer arrival times between earliest-feasible and tw_end, keeping arrivals <= tw_end and the return feasible), replay each, and record the MINIMUM delivered quality found
quality_counterexamples.expected: if any admissible schedule yields strictly lower delivered quality than the candidate stress bound, the bound is FALSIFIED and the counterexample schedule is reported
quality_counterexamples.must_not: reporting a bound as valid without attempting its falsification; and must_not upgrading the final label to CONSERVATIVE even if the search finds nothing, because a bounded search is not a proof
quality_counterexamples.assertion: the search result and the final label CONSERVATIVENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED are both present; falsified_bounds lists any counterexample found

legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.name: each legality gate is individually attributable
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.construction: four separate injections: unrevealed order, served order, duplicated order, closed-vehicle plan entry
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.expected: each is refused by ITS gate and named in the result
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.assertion: the refusal reason names revealed_only / no_served_in_plan / no_duplicate_order / plan_vehicle_set respectively, and no downstream component ran

legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.name: legal-input verdicts are unchanged by the reordering
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.construction: replay the B2 D5/D6/D7 style legal and violation cases after the reorder
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.expected: legal plans still pass every executable component; the previously demonstrated violations are still refused with the same responsible components
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.assertion: the post-reorder verdicts match the pre-reorder verdicts on the B2 cases

legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.name: illegal input must not crash and must remain attributable
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.construction: feed a plan whose entries reference an out-of-range customer and a vehicle absent from the live fleet
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.expected: a clean refusal with the gate named; no exception escapes
legality_short_circuit_counterexamples.assertion: no exception escapes and the result carries the gate name

contract_version_qualification_RISK.finding: this D3/M0 line runs v1 QualityConfig (ratio thresholds 0.8/0.85/0.9, initial_quality 1.0 for all classes, Arrhenius rate in compartment temperature). The A-v1 project main task states a FISH SALABILITY hard constraint under the v2 absolute sensory metric (fish initial 9, threshold 5).
contract_version_qualification_RISK.consequence: proving the v1 quality projection correct on D3/M0 does NOT automatically prove fish-salability certification on the A-v1 main task; they are different physics and different metric semantics
contract_version_qualification_RISK.required: the B3-Q qualification statement must NAME the applicable contract version; a future switch to v2 requires independently proving the quality model and the hard-constraint implementation, and must NOT reuse the v1 pass
contract_version_qualification_RISK.assertion: every projection result carries applicable_contract_version and the measured schema_version
